data.name: Emergency Crew 4: Call of the Ancestors
data.detailed_description:
The rescuers are now a large-scale organization, with great funding and influence! But... our heroes are bored. Now that all large-scale disasters are prevented on time, Stephen Shepard’s team simply has nothing to do. But it doesn’t matter! Our heroes go on a humanitarian trip to the most remote corners of the world, to the aid of wild tribes and ancient peoples. New cultures and amazing natural wonders await them ahead, as well as new obstacles! Will they be able to overcome them? Let's find out in Emergency crew 4 Call of ancestors!

Embark on a heroic journey to different parts of the world and save people! Exciting missions to eliminate the consequences of natural disasters in an exciting casual strategy Rescue Team 4. A huge number of unique missions, 50 levels, an addictive story about a team of comrades and friends, as well as adventures that only real rescuers can handle - all this awaits you here! Help people, restore natural wonders, help ancient clans and temples, protect wild animals and wisely distribute the necessary resources. Remember - time is valuable!

Functional controls and clear tutorials will help you easily understand the basics of the game.

"Rescue Team 4" - save people from the rampage of the cataclysm!

- Natural disasters - earthquakes, floods, fires, tsunamis!

- A team of professionals: rescuers, firefighters, doctors, police officers, rangers!

- Unique special equipment: rescue vehicles, boats and helicopters.

- Deep plot, colorful comics and characters, each with their own character!

- Production chains that allow you to produce more valuable resources!

- Lots of different tasks.

- 50 unique levels.

- 5 rescue mission locations: Suncity, Flooded East Island, Rainforest, Savannah and Coastland!

- Over 25 hours of addictive gameplay for all ages.

- Nice theme music."
